classification: Operator-enabled 900-second signed OracleSafetyCheck v3 validity for the bounded WAK Base Sepolia P1 handoff
receiptImpact: A new 900-second checkedAt/validUntil interval may be signed only when the operator enables WAK_P1_SIGNED_TTL_SECONDS=900 and authenticated audit metadata identifies workflow wak.insight-priorseal.p1.v1, schema 3, chain 84532, a WETH/USDC swap in either direction and declared tradeAmountUsd=4. The validity interval is inside the existing EIP-712 signed message. Default v3 and all v1/v2, sample, Oracle Watch and execution receipt paths retain their current rules. Previously signed evidence is never extended or edited. No schema layout, attester key, registry release or partner activation mapping changes.
activationRule: This promotion releases the opt-in implementation on main. The WAK-specific server configuration remains required for 900-second issuance; this bounded testnet workflow does not enable a new partner production verification route. Every active partner remains on its current immutable policy and the default signing path. WAK transaction signing/broadcast remains subject to a separately reviewed fresh bundle and explicit GO.
